meta.description: A per-column display override on a table. A table's column config is table-column children of the table item (the flat one-level rule, mirroring query-param), ordered by sortOrder — declaration order is column order. Result-set columns with no table-column child render after the declared ones, in result order, with default labels.

field.description: Result-set column name this override applies to (as returned by the query — the SELECT alias). Unique among the table's columns. A field that no longer appears in the result set is ignored, not an error.

label.description: Display name shown in the column header. Null means the field name is shown as-is.

width.description: Display width hint in pixels. Null means the grid chooses. Informational — the grid component may ignore this on small viewports.

hidden.description: When true the column is excluded from the grid (the value is still fetched — hiding is display-only). Null/false means visible.

sqlSchema: -- Built-in type: adapter handles storage natively.
